**Findings**

1. **[P2] Layer fallback swallows defects and interruption.**  
   [live.layer.ts:111](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/apps/codex-proxy/src/live.layer.ts:111) and [local.layer.ts:101](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/apps/codex-proxy/src/local.layer.ts:101) use `Layer.catchCause(() => unavailable)`. In the pinned Effect source, this catches the complete `Cause`, including defects and interruption. A deterministic local reproduction confirmed that `Effect.die("sentinel")` becomes a successful unavailable fallback. Consequently, programming defects can be misreported as an ordinary proxy-unavailable state without diagnostic evidence. Existing tests cover missing configuration, not defect or interruption preservation. Recover only expected typed acquisition failures and add deterministic defect/interruption tests.  
   **ENP:** `ENP-REQ-001`, `ENP-REQ-005`, `ENP-REQ-007`, `ENP-REQ-011`; `close-codex-provider-boundary-contracts`, `terminal-five-pass-audit`.

2. **[P2] Empty upstream chunks can evade every stream progress budget.**  
   [http-client.ts:97](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:97) applies the idle timeout to each stream pull, while byte accounting begins at [http-client.ts:107](/Users/cooper/.codex/worktrees/d4b4e069-1303-427d-957e-756d18e049a9/bundjil/packages/codex/src/provider/http-client.ts:107). Periodic zero-length chunks reset the pull timeout but add no bytes, lines, events, or field content. A controlled transport can therefore keep the function alive indefinitely without exhausting any current budget. The existing empty-chunk test covers CRLF parsing, not repeated no-progress pulls. Add a bounded no-progress policy and a `TestClock` termination/finalizer oracle.  
   **ENP:** `ENP-REQ-005`, `ENP-REQ-007`, `ENP-REQ-011`; `close-codex-provider-boundary-contracts`, `terminal-five-pass-audit`.

**Audit Result**

`PASS 1 FOUND 2 FINDINGS.` The terminal sequence should restart from Pass 1 after corrections.
